listen_address.description: IP address the metadata server binds to. Use '0.0.0.0' to listen on all interfaces.

listen_port.description: TCP port for gfmd client connections.

metadata_db_dir.description: Directory containing the metadata database files.

worker_threads.description: Number of worker threads to handle incoming connections.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections allowed.

max_metadata_cache_size_mb.description: Maximum size (MB) of metadata cache; 0 disables the limit.

replication_enabled.description: Enable replication between multiple gfmd instances for high availability.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of a replication peer gfmd.

port.description: Port of the replication peer gfmd.

replication_targets.description: List of gfmd instances to replicate metadata with. Each entry defines a peer for real-time metadata sync.

auth_method.description: Authentication method for gfmd clients. 'password' uses local user mapping; 'gssapi' enables Kerberos integration.

kerberos_keytab.description: Path to the Kerberos keytab file for GSSAPI authentication (only used if auth_method is 'gssapi').

default_quota_mb.description: Default disk quota (in MB) for new domains. Set to 0 for unlimited.

access_log_enabled.description: Enable detailed access logging of client operations.

access_log_file.description: Path to the access log file (only used if access logging is enabled).

log_file.description: Path to the main log file.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable SSL/TLS encryption for gfmd client connections.

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to the SSL certificate chain file (PEM format) for encrypted connections.

ssl_key_file.description: Path to the SSL private key file (PEM format, unencrypted).

acl_enabled.description: Enable POSIX ACL support for files and directories.

xattr_enabled.description: Enable extended attribute (xattr) support in the filesystem.
